skill.name: fiftyone-embeddings-visualization
skill.description: Guides agents through visualizing FiftyOne image datasets in 2D with embeddings, UMAP, t-SNE, PCA, and the FiftyOne Brain plugin.
skill.summary: Creates 2D embedding visualizations for FiftyOne datasets using Brain operators.
skill.author: AdonaiVera

static_findings.snippet: - `brain_key` - Unique identifier for this brain run
- `model` - Model from FiftyOne Model Zoo to generate embeddings
- `embeddings` - Field name where embeddings will be stored
- `clip-vit-base32-torch` - Best for general visual + semantic similarity
- `umap` - (Recommended) Preserves local and global structure, faster. Requires `umap-learn` package
- `tsne` - Better local structure, slower on large datasets. No extra dependencies.
- `pca` - Linear reduction, fastest but less informative
2. Select the brain key (e.g., `img_viz`) from the dropdown

**IMPORTANT:** Do NOT use `set_view(exists=["brain_key"])` - this filters samples and is not needed
Use `list_operators()` to discover and `get_operator_schema()` to see parameters:
| `@voxel51/brain/sort_by_similarity` | Sort by similarity to a query sample |
- Solution: Ensure `launch_app()` was called and wait 5-10 seconds
- Cause: UMAP method requires the `umap-learn` package
1. **Install umap-learn**: Ask user if they want to run `pip install umap-learn`
2. **Use t-SNE instead**: Change `method` to `"tsne"` (no extra dependencies)
3. **Use PCA instead**: Change `method` to `"pca"` (fastest, no extra dependencies)
1. **Discover dynamically** - Use `list_operators()` and `get_operator_schema()` to get current oper

content.value_statement: Image datasets can hide clusters, outliers, and label problems. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through FiftyOne embedding visualizations.
actual_capabilities: Sets the active FiftyOne dataset context before running visualization steps.
Launches the FiftyOne App so Brain plugin operators can execute.
Discovers Brain operators and schemas before selecting parameters.
Computes or reuses image embeddings for similarity and visualization workflows.
Creates 2D UMAP, t-SNE, or PCA visualizations for the Embeddings panel.
Guides users through coloring, filtering, and inspecting points in the app.
limitations: Requires a running FiftyOne MCP server and an image dataset already loaded.
Requires the FiftyOne Brain plugin for delegated visualization operators.
Large datasets can take minutes or hours to embed depending on model and hardware.
UMAP requires the separate umap-learn package, or users must choose t-SNE or PCA.

use_cases.title: Explore Dataset Structure
use_cases.description: Visualize image clusters, review dense regions, and find isolated samples before labeling or quality review.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Model Errors
use_cases.description: Compare ground truth and prediction patterns in embedding space to locate confusing classes and likely mistakes.

use_cases.title: Review Representation Quality
use_cases.description: Compare CLIP, DINOv2, ResNet, or MobileNet embeddings with UMAP, t-SNE, or PCA views.

prompt_templates.title: Visualize a Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the FiftyOne embeddings visualization workflow for dataset my-dataset. Check for existing embeddings, create a 2D UMAP view if needed, and tell me how to open it in the app.

prompt_templates.title: Find Outliers
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze dataset my-dataset for unusual images. Compute embeddings if needed, create an outlier-focused visualization, and explain where I should inspect isolated samples.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Classes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an embedding visualization for my-dataset and guide me through coloring points by ground truth and predictions. Highlight signs of class overlap or label issues.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Embedding Models
prompt_templates.prompt: For my-dataset, compare CLIP and DINOv2 embedding visualizations. Reuse existing fields when available, choose suitable reduction methods, and summarize the visual differences.

output_examples.input: Visualize my product-images dataset with UMAP.
output: The dataset context is set to product-images.
Existing CLIP embeddings were found and used for a 2D visualization named exploration.
Open the FiftyOne App and choose the exploration brain key in the Embeddings panel.

output_examples.input: Find likely outliers in my wildlife dataset.
output: A uniqueness score was computed for the dataset.
The highest uniqueness samples are sorted first for review.
Isolated points in the Embeddings panel are good candidates for annotation checks.

output_examples.input: Compare ground truth and predictions in embedding space.
output: A 2D embedding view was prepared for model review.
Color by ground truth to inspect class structure, then color by predictions to compare model behavior.
Regions where colors diverge are likely places to inspect prediction errors.

best_practices: Discover available operators and schemas before choosing parameters.
Reuse existing embedding fields when possible to avoid repeated computation.
Start with a subset for very large datasets before processing every sample.
anti_patterns: Do not filter samples by brain key when opening the Embeddings panel.
Do not assume UMAP is available when umap-learn is not installed.
Do not compute new embeddings when a suitable field already exists.

faq.question: What does this skill help me visualize?
faq.answer: It helps visualize image samples as 2D points based on model embeddings.

faq.question: Does it require FiftyOne?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a running FiftyOne MCP server and the FiftyOne App.

faq.question: Which embedding models does it suggest?
faq.answer: It suggests CLIP, DINOv2, ResNet50, and MobileNet depending on the analysis goal.

faq.question: Can it find outliers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compute uniqueness scores and show isolated points in an embedding view.

faq.question: Can it use existing embeddings?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow checks for existing embedding fields before computing new ones.

faq.question: What happens if UMAP is not installed?
faq.answer: The workflow can ask before installing umap-learn, or use t-SNE or PCA instead.
